## Checklist

- [ ] I read `DISCLAIMER.md` and do not imply organizational sponsorship,
      endorsement, data access, or approval.
- [ ] I did not add restricted telemetry, customer or employee data, exact
      facility locations, secrets, internal identifiers, or private outputs.
- [ ] Any dataset has a validated manifest, permission record, system boundary,
      content hash, research role, and known limitations.
- [ ] Any empirical result points to a frozen experiment manifest and held-out
      evaluation.
- [ ] Synthetic outputs remain labeled synthetic or simulated.
- [ ] I updated the model card, research protocol, or provenance when the claim
      boundary changed.
- [ ] Generated schemas are synchronized with the Pydantic contracts.
- [ ] Relevant backend and frontend checks pass.
- [ ] I verified that all third-party material can be used in this repository.
